topic: Database bridge update and installation issues
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on updating a system component, specifically the ClickHouse ODBC bridge. An initial attempt to install version 25.4.4.25 failed due to an unavailable installation candidate. It was noted that the `clickhouse-odbc-bridge` and `clickhouse-library-bridge` packages have been moved to a separate repository (https://github.com/ClickHouse/odbc-bridge/). This change means the versioning method for these bridges is different.
action_items: Investigate installation of ClickHouse ODBC bridge from the new dedicated GitHub repository.
